pages.text: Each tier comes with a sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel and hoe. All of them are unbreakable and carry permanent Efficiency and Fortune that scale with the tier.

$(b)Mushashite$(): Efficiency and Fortune IV.$(br)$(b)Joanfoite$(): Efficiency and Fortune VII.$(br)$(b)Nadienite$(): Efficiency and Fortune X.$(br2)Mushashite tools are forged from scratch; the other two are upgraded from the previous tier's tool.
